```{r, Helper Function - Rounding}

# Up to 6 digits
clean_round <- function(x, min_digits = 2, max_digits = 6) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (val == 0) return(sprintf(paste0("%.", min_digits, "f"), val))
    
    digits <- min_digits
    
    while (round(val, digits) == 0 && digits < max_digits) {
      digits <- digits + 1
    }
    
    sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), val)
  })
}

# Three decimals
clean_round_3 <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
}


```

```{r, Helper Function - JS Shrink}

#### James-Stein shrinkage function for primary outcomes #### 

# James-Stein shrinkage code based on Milkman et al (2022) 
# A 680,000-person megastudy of nudges to encourage vaccination in pharmacies 

shrink_condition_effects <- function(model, vcov_matrix, prefix = "condition") {
  
  # Identify intervention coefficients
  condition_names <- names(coef(model))[
    grepl(paste0("^", prefix), names(coef(model)))
  ]
  
  # Extract intervention estimates
  theta_hat <- coef(model)[condition_names]
  
  # Number of intervention estimates
  K <- length(theta_hat)
  
  # Mean intervention effect
  theta_line <- mean(theta_hat)
  
  # Pull variance-covariance matrix for intervention estimates
  V <- vcov_matrix[
    condition_names,
    condition_names,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Invert variance-covariance matrix
  V_inv <- solve(V)
  
  # Difference between each estimate and mean intervention effect
  theta_hat_minus_line <- theta_hat - theta_line
  
  # James-Stein shrinkage term
  numerator <- K - 3
  
  denominator <- as.numeric(
    t(theta_hat_minus_line) %*%
      V_inv %*%
      theta_hat_minus_line
  )
  
  term <- numerator / denominator
  
  # James-Stein estimates
  theta_js <- theta_hat - term * theta_hat_minus_line
  
  # Create data frame
  result <- data.frame(
    Condition = condition_names,
    Original = as.numeric(theta_hat),
    Shrunk = as.numeric(theta_js)
  )
  
  # Clean condition names
  result$Condition <- gsub(paste0("^", prefix), "", result$Condition)
  
  return(result)
}
```

# LM One-Tailed

```{r, Helper Function - LM One-Tailed with Shrinkage}

#### Tables - LM one-tailed #### 

format_lm_output_onetailed_shrink <- function(model1, model2,
                                              original_model,
                                              vcov_matrix,
                                              output_file_tex = "results_table.tex",
                                              prefix = "condition") {
  
  # Row names from model output
  term_names <- rownames(model1)
  
  # Identify intervention rows only
  is_intervention <- grepl(paste0("^", prefix), term_names)
  
  # Step 1: Calculate one-tailed p only for intervention effects (not intercept or any covariates)
  tvals <- model1[, "t value"]
  p_two <- model1[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  p_one <- ifelse(tvals > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
  
  # Final p: one-tailed for interventions (two-tailed for intercept or any covariates)
  p_final <- ifelse(is_intervention, p_one, p_two)
  
  # Step 2: Extract and adjust raw model results
  results_df <- data.frame(
    Term = term_names,
    Condition = gsub(paste0("^", prefix), "", term_names),
    b = model1[, "Estimate"],
    β = model2$coefficients,
    SE = model1[, "Std. Error"],
    t = tvals,
    p_two = p_two,
    p_one = p_one,
    p_final = p_final,
    is_intervention = is_intervention,
    Lower_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 1],
    Upper_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 2]
  )
  
  rownames(results_df) <- NULL
  
  # Step 3: Apply shrinkage only to intervention effects
  shrunk_df <- shrink_condition_effects(original_model, vcov_matrix, prefix = prefix)
  results_df <- left_join(results_df, shrunk_df, by = "Condition") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Original)
  
  ### Part 1: Full data frame
  full_info <- results_df
  
  ### Part 2: Cleaned version for appendix
  appendix_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = case_when(
        Term == "(Intercept)" ~ "(Intercept)",
        is_intervention ~ dplyr::recode(Condition, !!!variable_labels),
        TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(Term, !!!variable_labels)
      ),
      b = clean_round(b),
      β = clean_round(β),
      SE = clean_round(SE),
      t = clean_round(t),
      p = ifelse(p_final < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p_final))),
      Shrunk = ifelse(is.na(Shrunk), "", clean_round(Shrunk)),
      Lower_ci = clean_round(Lower_ci),
      Upper_ci = clean_round(Upper_ci),
      `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Variable,
      b, SE, t, p, 
      Shrunk,`90% CI` # Remove the CI for covariate tables since 90% only corresponds to one-tailed tests for interventions
    )
  
  colnames(appendix_table)[colnames(appendix_table) == "Shrunk"] <- "Shrunk (b)"
  
  align_spec <- c("l","l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  
  appendix_xtable <- xtable(appendix_table, align = align_spec, booktabs = TRUE)
  
  capture.output(print.xtable(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, floating = FALSE),
    file = output_file_tex)
  
  # Print appendix
  print(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
  
  ### Part 3: Subset for plotting
  plot_df <- results_df %>%
    filter(Condition %in% keep_conditions) %>%
    dplyr::select(Condition, b, Lower_ci, Upper_ci)
  
  return(list(full = full_info, appendix = appendix_table, plot = plot_df, appendix_xtable = appendix_xtable))
}

```

```{r, Helper Function - LM One-Tailed for Binary DV with Shrinkage}

#### Tables - LM one-tailed #### 

# Function:
format_lm_bin_output_onetailed_shrink <- function(model1, model2,
                                                  original_model,
                                                  vcov_matrix,
                                                  output_file_tex = "results_table.tex", 
                                                  prefix = "condition") {
  
  # Row names from model output
  term_names <- rownames(model1)
  
  # Identify intervention rows only
  is_intervention <- grepl(paste0("^", prefix), term_names)
  
  # Step 1: Calculate one-tailed p only for intervention effects (not intercept or any covariates)
  tvals <- model1[, "t value"]
  p_two <- model1[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  p_one <- ifelse(tvals > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
  
  # Final p: one-tailed for interventions (two-tailed for intercept or any covariates)
  p_final <- ifelse(is_intervention, p_one, p_two)
  
  # Step 2: Extract and adjust raw model results
  results_df <- data.frame(
    Term = term_names,
    Condition = gsub(paste0("^", prefix), "", term_names),
    b = model1[, "Estimate"],
    β = model2$coefficients,
    SE = model1[, "Std. Error"],
    t = tvals,
    p_two = p_two,
    p_one = p_one,
    p_final = p_final,
    is_intervention = is_intervention,
    Lower_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 1],
    Upper_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 2]
  )
  
   rownames(results_df) <- NULL
   
  # Step 3: Apply shrinkage only to intervention effects
  shrunk_df <- shrink_condition_effects(original_model, vcov_matrix, prefix = prefix)
  results_df <- left_join(results_df, shrunk_df, by = "Condition") %>%
    dplyr::select(-Original)
  
  ### Part 1: Full data frame 
  full_info <- results_df
  
  ### Part 2: Cleaned version for appendix
  appendix_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = case_when(
        Term == "(Intercept)" ~ "(Intercept)",
        is_intervention ~ dplyr::recode(Condition, !!!variable_labels),
        TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(Term, !!!variable_labels)
      ),
      'PP Inc.' = clean_round(b*100), 
      b = clean_round(b),
      β = clean_round(β),
      SE = clean_round(SE),
      t = clean_round(t),
      p = ifelse(p_final < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p_final))),
      Shrunk = ifelse(is.na(Shrunk), "", clean_round(Shrunk)),
      Lower_ci = clean_round(Lower_ci),
      Upper_ci = clean_round(Upper_ci),
      # Lower_ci = clean_round_3(Lower_ci), # Three decimals for reg outcome
      # Upper_ci = clean_round_3(Upper_ci),
      `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Variable, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, 
      t, p, 'Shrunk', `90% CI`) # Remove the CI for covariate tables since 90% corresponds to one-tailed for interventions
    
  colnames(appendix_table)[colnames(appendix_table) == "Shrunk"] <- "Shrunk (b)"
    
  align_spec <- c("l","l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
    
  appendix_xtable <- xtable(appendix_table, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
  
  capture.output(print.xtable(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, floating = FALSE),
                 file = output_file_tex)
  
  # Print appendix
  print(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
  
  ### Part 3: Subset for plotting
  plot_df <- results_df %>%
   filter(Condition %in% keep_conditions) %>%  
   dplyr::select(Condition, b, Lower_ci, Upper_ci) 
  
  return(list(full = full_info, appendix = appendix_table, plot = plot_df, appendix_xtable = appendix_xtable))
}
```

```{r, Helper Function - LM One-Tailed for Binary DV}
  # Row names from model output
  term_names <- rownames(model1)
  
  # Identify intervention rows only
  is_intervention <- grepl(paste0("^", prefix), term_names)
  
  # Step 1: Calculate one-tailed p only for intervention effects (not intercept or any covariates)
  tvals <- model1[, "t value"]
  p_two <- model1[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  p_one <- ifelse(tvals > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
  
  # Final p: one-tailed for interventions (two-tailed for intercept or any covariates)
  p_final <- ifelse(is_intervention, p_one, p_two)
  
  # Step 2: Extract and adjust raw model results
  results_df <- data.frame(
    Term = term_names,
    Condition = gsub(paste0("^", prefix), "", term_names),
    b = model1[, "Estimate"],
    β = model2$coefficients,
    SE = model1[, "Std. Error"],
    t = tvals,
    p_two = p_two,
    p_one = p_one,
    p_final = p_final,
    is_intervention = is_intervention,
    Lower_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 1],
    Upper_ci = confint(model1, level = 0.90)[, 2]
  )
  
   rownames(results_df) <- NULL
  
  ### Part 1: Full data frame 
  full_info <- results_df
  
  ### Part 2: Cleaned version for appendix
  appendix_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = case_when(
        Term == "(Intercept)" ~ "(Intercept)",
        is_intervention ~ dplyr::recode(Condition, !!!variable_labels),
        TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(Term, !!!variable_labels)
      ),
      'PP Inc.' = clean_round(b*100), 
      b = clean_round(b),
      β = clean_round(β),
      SE = clean_round(SE),
      t = clean_round(t),
      p = ifelse(p_final < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p_final))),
      Lower_ci = clean_round(Lower_ci),
      Upper_ci = clean_round(Upper_ci),
      `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Variable, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, 
      t, p,`90% CI`) # Remove the CI for covariate tables since 90% only corresponds to one-tailed tests for interventions
    
  align_spec <- c("l","l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
    
  appendix_xtable <- xtable(appendix_table, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
  
  capture.output(print.xtable(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, floating = FALSE),
                 file = output_file_tex)
  
  # Print appendix
  print(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
  
  ### Part 3: Subset for plotting
  plot_df <- results_df %>%
   filter(Condition %in% keep_conditions) %>%  
   dplyr::select(Condition, b, Lower_ci, Upper_ci) 
  
  return(list(full = full_info, appendix = appendix_table, plot = plot_df, appendix_xtable = appendix_xtable))
}
```

```{r, Helper Function - GLM One-Tailed}
#### Tables - GLM one-tailed #### 

# Function:
format_logit_output_onetailed <- function(model, 
                                output_file_tex = "results_table.tex", 
                                prefix = "condition") {
  
  
  
  # Row names from model output
  term_names <- rownames(model)
  
  # Identify intervention rows only
  is_intervention <- grepl(paste0("^", prefix), term_names)
  
  # Step 1: Calculate one-tailed p only for intervention effects (not intercept or any covariates)
  zvals <- model[, "z value"]
  p_two <- model[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  p_one <- ifelse(zvals > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
  
  # Final p: one-tailed for interventions (two-tailed for intercept or any covariates)
  p_final <- ifelse(is_intervention, p_one, p_two)
  
  # Step 2: Extract and adjust raw model results
  results_df <- data.frame(
    Term = term_names,
    Condition = gsub(paste0("^", prefix), "", term_names),
    Log_Odds = model[, "Estimate"],
    SE_LO = model[, "Std. Error"],
    z = model[, "z value"],
    p_two = p_two,
    p_one = p_one,
    p_final = p_final,
    is_intervention = is_intervention,
    Lower_ci_LO = confint(model, level = 0.90)[, 1],
    Upper_ci_LO = confint(model, level = 0.90)[, 2]
  )
  
   rownames(results_df) <- NULL
  
  # Step 4: Convert log-odds to odds ratios
  results_df$OR <- exp(results_df$Log_Odds)
  results_df$Lower_ci <- exp(results_df$Lower_ci_LO)
  results_df$Upper_ci <- exp(results_df$Upper_ci_LO)
  results_df$d <- logoddsratio_to_d(results_df$Log_Odds) # Do not need to report since OR is already an effect size
  
  ### Part 1: Full data frame 
  full_info <- results_df
  
  ### Part 2: Cleaned version for appendix
  appendix_table <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = case_when(
        Term == "(Intercept)" ~ "(Intercept)",
        is_intervention ~ dplyr::recode(Condition, !!!variable_labels),
        TRUE ~ dplyr::recode(Term, !!!variable_labels)
      ),
      Log_Odds = sprintf("%.2f", Log_Odds), # Round
      OR = sprintf("%.2f", OR),  
      SE_LO = sprintf("%.2f", SE_LO),
      z = sprintf("%.2f", z),
      p = ifelse(p_final < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p_final))), # Use one-tailed
      Lower_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci), # CI in brackets
      Upper_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci),
      `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable,
           OR, z, p,
           `90% CI`) # Remove the CI for covariate tables since 90% only corresponds to one-tailed tests for interventions
  
  align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  
  appendix_xtable <- xtable(appendix_table, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
  capture.output(print.xtable(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, floating = FALSE),
                 file = output_file_tex)
  
  # Print appendix
  print(appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
  
  # No plot needed
  
  return(list(full = full_info, appendix = appendix_table, appendix_xtable = appendix_xtable))
}
```

# ANOVA 

```{r, Format ANOVA from regression}

format_anova_type3_to_latex <- function(model,
                                       output_file_tex = NULL,  # NULL = don't save
                                       include_intercept = TRUE) {

  # Type III ANOVA
  a3 <- car::Anova(model, type = "III")
  tab <- as.data.frame(a3)
  tab$Term <- rownames(tab)
  rownames(tab) <- NULL

  # Optionally drop intercept
  if (!include_intercept) {
    tab <- tab %>% dplyr::filter(Term != "(Intercept)")
  }

  # Build table in your style
  appendix_table <- tab %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Variable = dplyr::recode(Term, !!!variable_labels),
      `Sum Sq` = clean_round(`Sum Sq`),
      df = clean_round(Df),
      `F` = ifelse(is.na(`F value`), "", clean_round(`F value`)),
      p = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(`Pr(>F)`) ~ "",
        `Pr(>F)` < 0.001 ~ "<.001",
        TRUE ~ sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", `Pr(>F)`))
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable, `Sum Sq`, df, `F`, p)

  # xtable align: first entry is for rownames (even if excluded)
  align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")

  appendix_xtable <- xtable::xtable(appendix_table, align = align_spec, booktabs = TRUE)

  tex_lines <- capture.output(
    print(appendix_xtable,
          include.rownames = FALSE,
          sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
          sanitize.text.function = identity,
          floating = FALSE)
  )
  tex_text <- paste(tex_lines, collapse = "\n")

  # Print 
  cat(tex_text, sep = "\n")

  # Optionally save
  if (!is.null(output_file_tex)) {
    writeLines(tex_lines, con = output_file_tex)
  }

  return(list(
    appendix = appendix_table,
    appendix_xtable = appendix_xtable,
    latex = tex_text
  ))
}
```

```{r, Helper Function - Mediation Formatting}

#### Tables - Mediations #### 

# For mediations
format_mediation_output <- function(mediation_model, mediator_name) {
  
  # Extract estimates and confidence intervals
  estimates <- data.frame(
    Effect = c("ACME", "ADE", "Total Effect", "Prop. Mediated"),
    Estimate = c(
      mediation_model$d.avg,      # ACME (indirect)
      mediation_model$z.avg,      # ADE (direct)
      mediation_model$tau.coef,   # Total effect
      mediation_model$n.avg       # Prop. Mediated (average)
    ),
    LowerCI = c(
      mediation_model$d.avg.ci[1],
      mediation_model$z.avg.ci[1],
      mediation_model$tau.ci[1],
      mediation_model$n.avg.ci[1]
    ),
    UpperCI = c(
      mediation_model$d.avg.ci[2],
      mediation_model$z.avg.ci[2],
      mediation_model$tau.ci[2],
      mediation_model$n.avg.ci[2]
    ),
    p_value = c(
      mediation_model$d.avg.p,
      mediation_model$z.avg.p,
      mediation_model$tau.p,
      mediation_model$n.avg.p
    )
  )
  
  # Round numerical columns
  estimates$Estimate <- clean_round(estimates$Estimate)
  estimates$LowerCI  <- clean_round(estimates$LowerCI)
  estimates$UpperCI  <- clean_round(estimates$UpperCI)
  
  # Format p-values
  format_p_value <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) {
      return("")
    } else if (p < 0.001) {
      return("<.001")
    } else {
      return(sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
    }
  }
  
  estimates$p_value <- sapply(estimates$p_value, format_p_value)
  
  # Select and rename columns 
  estimates <- estimates[, c("Effect", "Estimate", "LowerCI", "UpperCI", "p_value")]
  colnames(estimates) <- c("Effect", "Estimate", "95 % Lower", "95 % Upper", "p")

  # Define alignment and digits for xtable
  align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")

  appendix_xtable <- xtable(
    estimates,
    align = align_spec,
    booktabs = TRUE
  )
  
  capture.output(
    print.xtable(
      appendix_xtable,
      include.rownames = FALSE,
      sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
      floating = FALSE
    )
  )

  return(appendix_xtable)
}
```

```{r, Helper Function - Sensivity Analyses}

### Sensitivity Analyses ###

sensitivity_plot <- function(data, X, M, Y, model = c("lm", "glm"), condition_var = "condition", 
                             treatment_condition = "CorrectingMisperceptions") {
    data <- data[!is.na(data[[M]]),]
    
    mx <- as.formula(paste0(M, " ~ ", X))
    ymx <- as.formula(paste0(Y, " ~ ", M, " + ", X))
    
    if (model == "lm") {
        fit_mx <- lm(mx, data = data)
        fit_ymx <- lm(ymx, data = data)
    } else if (model == "glm") {
        fit_mx <- lm(mx, data = data)
        fit_ymx <- glm(ymx, data = data, family = binomial(link = "probit"))
    }
    
    fit_mx$call$formula <- mx
    fit_ymx$call$formula <- ymx
    
    med.out <- mediate(fit_mx, fit_ymx, treat = condition_var, mediator = M, control.value = "ControlCondition", treat.value = treatment_condition, robustSE = TRUE, sims = 100)
    print(1)
    print(summary(med.out))
    print(2)
    sens.out <- medsens(med.out, rho.by = 0.05, effect.type = "indirect", sims = 100)
    print(summary(sens.out))
    
    pdf(file = paste0(M, "_mediation.pdf"))
    plot(sens.out)
    dev.off()
}

X <- "condition"
```

##

# Lee Bounds

```{r, Helper Function - Lee Bounds}

# Function to compute Lee bounds for one treatment and one outcome
lee_bounds_simple <- function(data, outcome, treat, control = "ControlCondition") {
  
  # Keep only treatment and control rows
  df <- data %>%
    filter(condition %in% c(control, treat)) %>%
    mutate(
      T = ifelse(condition == treat, 1, 0),
      observed = Finished == "True" & !is.na(.data[[outcome]]) # Value observed if finished the survey and if have a value for the outcome
    )
  
  # Compute retention rates
  r_t <- mean(df$observed[df$T == 1])
  r_c <- mean(df$observed[df$T == 0])
  
  # Keep only observed cases for trimming
  df_obs <- df %>% filter(observed)
  
  # Actual untrimmed estimate from observed data
  actual_est <- coef(lm(df_obs[[outcome]] ~ df_obs$T))[2]
  
  # If retention is identical, bounds equal the original estimate
  if (abs(r_t - r_c) < 1e-6) {
    return(data.frame(
      treatment = treat,
      outcome = outcome,
      actual_estimate = actual_est,
      lower_bound = actual_est,
      upper_bound = actual_est
    ))
  }
  
  # Figure out which group to trim
  if (r_t > r_c) {
    trim_group <- 1
    trim_prop <- 1 - (r_c / r_t)
  } else {
    trim_group <- 0
    trim_prop <- 1 - (r_t / r_c)
  }
  
  # Helper function to trim low or high values
  trim_data <- function(direction) {
    
    d_trim <- df_obs %>%
      filter(T == trim_group) %>%
      arrange(.data[[outcome]])
    
    d_keep <- df_obs %>%
      filter(T != trim_group)
    
    n <- nrow(d_trim)
    k <- floor(trim_prop * n)
    
    if (k == 0) {
      return(bind_rows(d_keep, d_trim))
    }
    
    if (direction == "low") {
      d_trim <- d_trim[(k + 1):n, ]
    } else {
      d_trim <- d_trim[1:(n - k), ]
    }
    
    bind_rows(d_keep, d_trim)
  }
  
  # Create lower and upper bound datasets
  if (trim_group == 1) {
    d_lb <- trim_data("high")
    d_ub <- trim_data("low")
  } else {
    d_lb <- trim_data("low")
    d_ub <- trim_data("high")
  }
  
  # Estimate the bound effects
  lb <- coef(lm(d_lb[[outcome]] ~ d_lb$T))[2]
  ub <- coef(lm(d_ub[[outcome]] ~ d_ub$T))[2]
  
  # Return results
  data.frame(
    treatment = treat,
    outcome = outcome,
    actual_estimate = actual_est,
    lower_bound = lb,
    upper_bound = ub
  )
}

```
